description: This file contains implementations of real-time OpenAI language model contexts and aggregators, including classes for managing session state, message conversion, and frame processing in a real-time environment. It also includes deprecated patterns and migration guidance.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext
classes.description: A subclass of OpenAILLMContext supporting real-time session management, message conversion, and upgrade functionality, with deprecation notices.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeUserContextAggregator
classes.description: An aggregator handling user input frames in real-time, managing message updates and tool settings, with deprecation notices.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: An aggregator for assistant output frames, filtering duplicates and handling function call results, with deprecation notices.

methods.name: upgrade_to_realtime
methods.description: Static method to upgrade a standard OpenAILLMContext to a realtime context.

methods.name: from_standard_message
methods.description: Converts a standard message dictionary into a realtime conversation item.

methods.name: get_messages_for_initializing_history
methods.description: Prepares conversation history for session initialization in realtime API.

methods.name: add_user_content_item_as_message
methods.description: Adds a user content item as a standard message to the context.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling realtime-specific frame types for user and assistant aggregators.

methods.name: push_aggregation
methods.description: Placeholder method to push user input aggregation; currently ignores input.

methods.name: handle_function_call_result
methods.description: Handles function call result frames and notifies the realtime service.
